doc.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Lydian book publication and marriage to Juanita
title: Meeting Juanita through Dizzy at John Lewis's house
summary: He tells how Dizzy walked Juanita into the bathroom where he sat covered in Magic Shave while living with John Lewis in Jamaica.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: We may do some followup reference. So the late ’40s, maybe? How did you all meet?
Dizzy.
Oh yeah? While you were with Dizzy, through Dizzy?
They used to make some stuff called – some god-awful stuff – that men, I think mostly black men like us, put on our face to – and it smelled.
Magic Shave?

Yeah. It was awful. I was living with John Lewis in Jamaica, New York, out in a nice neighborhood in Jamaica, because he saw in me talent and he wanted to enrich that and see. So when I was living on the Bowery, he said, “I can’t let you live like this.”
That’s a friend.

Yeah, a sweetheart. So I was out there. Dizzy lived close by. John was playing with Dizzy’s band at the time, John Lewis was. He’d come home after a gig and run his head into the wall, right into the wall. He was so . . .
Frustrated?
Yeah, because he wasn’t a clown. John was very serious.
Dizzy liked to clown around.

He wasn’t given to these spontaneous ideas that Dizzy – like Dizzy. For example, John had left, going to New York. I was taking a bath, in the bathroom. The bell rang or something. Somehow I got the door open, and it was Dizzy. I’m in the bathtub. Dizzy’s coming in, and I have all this . . .
Magic Shave.
Yeah, Magic, so called Magic. The place was smelling awful. He had a girl with him, and it was Juanita. He said, “Come. I want you to meet.” Takes me in the bathroom. I’m naked.
Brings her right in, first time in.
“This is my arranger,” he’d say.
What did he call you? His what?
Arranger.
Arranger. What did that mean?
[recording interrupted]
Here you are in the bathtub with this Magic Shave on, the house is stinking, and in walks Dizzy with Juanita and says, “This is my arranger.”
